| Column | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| **Tag** | the number on the wire. Widget tags are `(segment shl 24) or local`, so this segment's are `254 shl 24` plus the local tag — which is how a number in a skew report becomes a name |

Two rules govern every number here, and both are enforced by the lock beside the surface:

- **Tags are permanent and append-only.** A renumbered tag does not fail to render; it
